notes.title: March 5th Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Thanks to you guys for catching the bug. Our programmer has been interrogated once again and he has kowtowed, bonbonbonbon.
Fixed the bug where the Collect All Weapons and Activate All Weapons Combos achievements could not be completed under certain circumstances.

notes.title: Update on March 4th: The Workshop is now open.
notes.notes: Hey boyos,after our programming pros worked tirelessly day and night, we've finally cracked the Workshop. You can now upload your own models to swap out the succubi in the game. Who knows, maybe some of you will drop some goodies in the  Workshop too, hehehe. The game's playability has just taken a leap forward.

notes.title: March 1st update and follow-up plan
notes.notes:
Hey boyos, the weather we've been having here lately has been both colder and hotter, so pay more attention to what you're wearing and what you're cutting down on. 

The game is all about meme, so some translations are inevitably inaccurate and unreadable. Please be kind to our translator who have lost his mind and ignore those things (or not).

This is a big step for this game, which is about to enter the international market and bring new shocks to the global gaming industry. Here are some details about this update:

    1.New weapon combo: Fourteen Injury Fist
    2.New Achievement: Fist
    3.English version 

Future update plan:
Steam Workshop Support
